:::{#exr-solve-normal-equations-vector}
#### Solving the normal equations in vector notation

Assuming $\sspred > 0$ (@def-centered-sums),
show that $A$ from @exr-normal-equations-vector is invertible,
solve $A \vcoef = \v{c}$ for $\vcoef$,
and compare the result with @exr-solve-normal-equations.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-solve-normal-equations-vector}

Write out the entries of each term of $A$ and $\v{c}$, then add them up:

$$
\begin{aligned}
A
&= \sumin \soprod{\vxi}
&& \text{(definition of $A$)}\\
&= \sumin \begin{pmatrix} 1 & \predvar_\iobs \\ \predvar_\iobs & \predvar_\iobs^2 \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(outer product of $\vxi$)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix} \sumin 1 & \sumin \predvar_\iobs \\ \sumin \predvar_\iobs & \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(matrices add entrywise)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix} n & \sumin \predvar_\iobs \\ \sumin \predvar_\iobs & \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(sum of a constant)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix} n & n\predbar \\ n\predbar & \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs = n \predbar$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
\v{c}
&= \sumin \vxi \outvar_\iobs
&& \text{(definition of $\v{c}$)}\\
&= \sumin \begin{pmatrix} \outvar_\iobs \\ \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(scalar times a vector)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix} \sumin \outvar_\iobs \\ \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(vectors add entrywise)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix} n\outbar \\ \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{($\sumin \outvar_\iobs = n \outbar$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The determinant of $A$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}
\det A
&= n \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - \paren{n\predbar} \paren{n\predbar}
&& \text{(determinant of a $2 \times 2$ matrix)}\\
&= n \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - n^2 \predbar^2
&& \text{(multiply)}\\
&= n \paren{\sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - n \predbar^2}
&& \text{(factor out $n$)}\\
&= n \sspred
&& \text{(expansion of $\sspred$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

where the last step uses @exr-sxx-expand.
Since $n > 0$ and $\sspred > 0$, $\det A > 0$,
so $A$ is invertible,
and $A \vcoef = \v{c}$ has exactly one solution, $A^{-1} \v{c}$.

To simplify $A^{-1} \v{c}$, we need two expansions of uncentered sums.
Adding $n \predbar^2$ to both sides of @exr-sxx-expand gives
$\sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 = \sspred + n \predbar^2$.
The cross-product sum expands the same way:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sspredout
&= \sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)(\outvar_\iobs - \outbar)
&& \text{(definition of $\sspredout$)}\\
&= \sumin \paren{\predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \predvar_\iobs \outbar - \predbar \outvar_\iobs + \predbar \outbar}
&& \text{(expand the product)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outbar - \sumin \predbar \outvar_\iobs + \sumin \predbar \outbar
&& \text{(sum of a sum)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \outbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs - \sumin \predbar \outvar_\iobs + \sumin \predbar \outbar
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \outbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs - \predbar \sumin \outvar_\iobs + \sumin \predbar \outbar
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \outbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs - \predbar \sumin \outvar_\iobs + n \predbar \outbar
&& \text{(sum of a constant)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \outbar \paren{n \predbar} - \predbar \sumin \outvar_\iobs + n \predbar \outbar
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs = n \predbar$)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - \outbar \paren{n \predbar} - \predbar \paren{n \outbar} + n \predbar \outbar
&& \text{($\sumin \outvar_\iobs = n \outbar$)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - n \predbar \outbar - n \predbar \outbar + n \predbar \outbar
&& \text{(reorder the factors)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - n \predbar \outbar
&& \text{(combine like terms)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Adding $n \predbar \outbar$ to both sides gives
$\sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs = \sspredout + n \predbar \outbar$.
Now compute the solution:

$$
\begin{aligned}
A^{-1} \v{c}
&= \frac{1}{\det A}
  \begin{pmatrix} \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 & -n\predbar \\ -n\predbar & n \end{pmatrix}
  \v{c}
&& \text{(inverse of a $2 \times 2$ matrix)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n \sspred}
  \begin{pmatrix} \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 & -n\predbar \\ -n\predbar & n \end{pmatrix}
  \v{c}
&& \text{($\det A = n \sspred$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n \sspred}
  \begin{pmatrix} \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 & -n\predbar \\ -n\predbar & n \end{pmatrix}
  \begin{pmatrix} n\outbar \\ \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(substitute $\v{c}$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n \sspred}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 \cdot n\outbar + \paren{-n\predbar} \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \\
  \paren{-n\predbar} \cdot n\outbar + n \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(matrix times a vector)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n \sspred}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  n \outbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - n \predbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \\
  -n^2 \predbar \outbar + n \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(multiply out the products)}\\
&= \frac{1}{n \sspred} \, n
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \outbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - \predbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \\
  -n \predbar \outbar + \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(factor $n$ out of the vector)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\sspred}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \outbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - \predbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \\
  -n \predbar \outbar + \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(cancel $n$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\sspred}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \outbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 - \predbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \\
  \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - n \predbar \outbar
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(reorder the terms of the second entry)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\sspred}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \outbar \paren{\sspred + n\predbar^2} - \predbar \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs \\
  \sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs - n \predbar \outbar
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 = \sspred + n\predbar^2$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\sspred}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \outbar \paren{\sspred + n\predbar^2} - \predbar \paren{\sspredout + n\predbar\outbar} \\
  \paren{\sspredout + n\predbar\outbar} - n \predbar \outbar
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs \outvar_\iobs = \sspredout + n\predbar\outbar$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\sspred}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \outbar \sspred + \outbar n\predbar^2 - \predbar \sspredout - \predbar n\predbar\outbar \\
  \sspredout + n\predbar\outbar - n \predbar \outbar
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(distribute)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\sspred}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \outbar \sspred + n\predbar^2\outbar - \predbar \sspredout - n\predbar\predbar\outbar \\
  \sspredout + n\predbar\outbar - n \predbar \outbar
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(reorder the factors)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\sspred}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \outbar \sspred + n\predbar^2\outbar - \predbar \sspredout - n\predbar^2\outbar \\
  \sspredout + n\predbar\outbar - n \predbar \outbar
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{($\predbar \predbar = \predbar^2$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\sspred}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \outbar \sspred - \predbar \sspredout \\
  \sspredout + n\predbar\outbar - n \predbar \outbar
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(first entry: cancel $\pm n\predbar^2\outbar$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{\sspred}
  \begin{pmatrix}
  \outbar \sspred - \predbar \sspredout \\
  \sspredout
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(second entry: cancel $\pm n\predbar\outbar$)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix}
  \outbar \sspred / \sspred - \predbar \, \sspredout / \sspred \\
  \sspredout / \sspred
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(multiply each entry by $1 / \sspred$)}\\
&= \begin{pmatrix}
  \outbar - \predbar \, \sspredout / \sspred \\
  \sspredout / \sspred
  \end{pmatrix}
&& \text{(cancel $\sspred$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Its entries are $\intcoef = \outbar - \coef{x} \predbar$ and $\coef{x} = \sspredout / \sspred$,
the same solution as @exr-solve-normal-equations.

:::
